cohort: 50 neonates who died at RSUD Dr. Abdoer Rahem Situbondo between 2015-2016
finding: Neonatal mortality was associated with neonatal factors (male sex, low birth weight, prematurity, asphyxia), maternal factors (age <20 or >35 years, low education, low income, poor nutrition), and healthcare factors.
gest_age: Not specified, but study included premature infants
followup_time: Neonatal period (up to 28 days after birth)
birth_weight: Not specified, but study included low birth weight infants
